lemmas.name: rm64
lemmas.statement: ∀ (lst : List Nat) (target : Nat) (h : removeElement_precond lst target), removeElement_postcond lst target (lst.filter (fun x => decide (x ≠ target))) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro lst target h
  unfold removeElement_postcond
  dsimp only
  refine ⟨?_, rfl⟩
  rw [List.all_eq_true]
  rintro ⟨x, i⟩ hx
  have := (List.mem_zipIdx_iff_getElem?.mp hx)
  simp only at this
  rw [this]
  simp
